status: PROVISIONAL: every value here is undecided by the owner and may change; the pool's params_hash is the sha256 of this file

winner.area: number of provinces whose keep the nation holds when the season has ended (Province.keep.holder on chain)

capture.rule: for each province the winning nation holds at the end whose keep was captured during the season: the owner of the host that garrisoned it at its LAST capture

support.disabledBecause: the game has no reinforcement of a keep garrison: keep troops come from the one donor host of the capture and never regrow, so there is nothing to attribute beyond the capture itself

defence.disabledBecause: the chain's record of a repelled contest (CONQUEST event KEEP_BROKEN) names nations only, and the herald's contest list carries no transaction signature; no line could cite the transaction it derives from
